describe:
Prepay Loan, in the slate colours, always in dark mode.
Works out:
- r is rate divided by 1200.
- n is years times 12.
- pay is loan times r divided by the result of 1 minus the pow of 1 plus r when r is more than 0, otherwise loan divided by the larger of n and 1.
- m2 is how many of the number from 1 to 600 have the result of loan times the pow of 1 plus r minus the result of pay plus extra times the result of the pow of 1 plus r minus 1 divided by the larger of r and 0.000001 is more than 1 plus 1.
- int1 is pay times n minus loan.
- int2 is the result of pay plus extra times m2 minus loan.
needs: months to finish with and without extra
